name: rm-buyer-pending-expired
subject: Your pending trade has expired
previewText: The money reserved for this trade is now available to you

fields.heading: Your pending trade has expired
fields.body:
Hello {first_name},

Your pending trade has expired because an agreement between you and the seller was not reached within the 5 day timeframe. The money reserved for this trade has been returned to your available Abundance account balance.

If a trade is not agreed by both parties and concluded within 5 days, the trade is automatically expired. This is to ensure the buyer’s money is not indefinitely reserved and allow the seller to re-list the investment for sale.
